one_line: For |R|≥3, Theorem 4.35 already characterizes X_R as prime exactly when R is semisimple, is not a field, and has at most one Wedderburn factor isomorphic to F₂.
caveats: This uses the standard unitary Cayley graph of a finite unital ring; R = F₂ gives K₂, whose status depends on the small-graph convention.
